description: This PHP source file defines the class OA_DB_Integrity, which provides methods for database and schema integrity checks, schema file handling, data dumping/loading, and migration task management within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_DB_Integrity
classes.description: A class providing methods for database schema integrity, data import/export, and migration task management in the Revive Adserver.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes database connection and schema definition based on version and database name.

methods.name: getSchemaFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves schema file header information from a specified directory and data file.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns information about whether the database can be upgraded and the initial application and schema versions.

methods.name: dumpData
methods.description: Exports database data to an XML file, excluding certain tables based on patterns.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads data from an XML file into the database, creating or updating tables as needed.

methods.name: checkIntegrityQuick
methods.description: Performs a quick integrity check and schema validation for a specific version.

methods.name: checkIntegrity
methods.description: Performs a full integrity check, including schema and destructive/constructive task validation.

methods.name: compileExecuteTasklist
methods.description: Compiles, prunes, and optionally executes schema migration tasks, updating schema version if requested.

methods.name: mockMigration
methods.description: Creates a mock migrator object for testing migration tasks.

methods.name: pruneTasklist
methods.description: Prunes the list of migration tasks based on specified timing ('constructive' or 'destructive').

methods.name: getConstructiveOK
methods.description: Checks if the constructive task list is empty, indicating readiness.

methods.name: getDestructiveOK
methods.description: Checks if the destructive task list is empty, indicating readiness.

methods.name: _clearProperties
methods.description: Resets internal task and version properties.

methods.name: _initDBUpgrader
methods.description: Initializes the database upgrader with schema paths and filenames.

methods.name: _getXMLFilename
methods.description: Generates the XML filename for schema or change files based on prefix and version.
